description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton, and provides functionality for rendering a 'Compose Email' button in a subpanel within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for generating the button's HTML, handling ACL permissions, and integrating with email client logic.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Compose Email' button in subpanels, with logic for ACL checks, email address retrieval, and UI rendering.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique widget ID, setting the button label from language strings.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Constructs the HTML for the compose email button, considering ACL permissions, email client, and bean properties.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the button if the user has edit permissions; otherwise returns empty.
